_readme: FIXTURE FILE. Self-test inputs only. Nothing in this file is read by the production
path: e2b/experiments/*.py contains no accession, gene, disease or dataset identifier,
and plan_experiments() never opens this file. It exists so the three topology branches
of the planner can be exercised against REAL, live UniProt records.
The three accessions were chosen for TOPOLOGY CLASS, not for any indication: one
secreted protein, one single-pass surface receptor, one cytosolic enzyme. The briefs
here are test briefs. The candidate is NOT a design: it is a synthetic string used to
exercise the construct-liability screen, and it is labelled origin='fixture'. No design
metric, score or affinity is attached to it anywhere.

targets.label: secreted-protein branch
pathway_hints: JAK-STAT signalling downstream of a type-2 cytokine receptor complex

targets.label: cell-surface-receptor branch
pathway_hints: cytokine receptor subunit alpha; JAK-STAT signal transduction

briefs.desired_effect: suppress the pathway the target drives
restore signalling through the pathway by blocking the target

_what_this_is: NOT a design and NOT a biological result. A synthetic amino-acid string whose only
purpose is to exercise the construct-liability screen: it contains exactly one
cysteine (so the free-thiol branch fires) and one N-X-S/T sequon (so the
glycosylation-sequon branch fires). It carries no metrics, because none exist.
